Bill.BriefDescription: Providing a sales tax exemption for trail grooming.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a sales tax exemption for trailgrooming on stateowned land; and adding a new section to chapter 82.08RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales of trailgrooming services to the Washington state parks and recreationcommission. For the purposes of this section, "trail grooming" meansthe activity of snow compacting, snow redistribution, or snow removalon stateowned trails.
